_doc: GENERATED by scripts/build-fii-food-classes.mjs — do not hand-edit. Per fdcId: `fs` = the WHO free-sugar fraction of the food's total sugars (Louie 2015 / Wanselius 2019 decision tree; `fsRule` names the step that decided it), `trans` = the origin of its trans fat (industrial or natural), `fv` marks fruit and vegetables (whose sugars `prep: blended|juiced` re-classifies) and `matrix` the food-matrix class (fii-parameters.json matrixDeltas). Read by src/core/fii.ts. A food with no sugar, no trans fat and no class is omitted (nothing to classify); the engine treats a sugar-bearing food missing from the file as unclassified (Louie step 10, half free), and a test requires every recipe-used food with sugar to be classified.
